detail.title: Automated Detection of Objective Misspecification in Complex Systems
detail.summary: An examination of how automated reward design and objective specification methods approach hidden misspecifications in complex optimization tasks, noting current bottlenecks in automated formulation and scientific evaluation.
detail.reason: Synthesizing collected evidence for project p-objective-misspecification to satisfy synthesis readiness requirements.
